pages.title: Next step
text: One concrete thing to do, read from where you are on the path from the first hearth to the Ninth Agreement. It changes as you go.
You now have a camp that makes its own power. From here, follow whatever you are curious about:
- [Workshops](echo_attune) turn shards into stronger crystals, metals and upgrades.
- [Camp Machines](grove_tender) farm, gather and guard while you are busy.
- [Storage & Travel](ancestral_cache) moves goods without pipes, and you with them.
- [Patterns](placement_is_the_ritual) are built rather than crafted: the Stone Font and the Listening Pit.
- The [Gate Drum](gate_drum) opens the way to the March, when you are ready for it.
